{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Number of duplicates: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")

# Check site values
print(f"Unique sites: {df['site'].unique()}")

# Check assay_batch
print(f"Unique assay_batch: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")

# Check response rate in raw data
print(f"Total responded (raw): {(df['responded'] == 1).sum()}")
print(f"Total patients (raw): {len(df)}")

# Check for re-tests (multiple sample_seq per patient)
df_sample_seq_max = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {len(df_sample_seq_max[df_sample_seq_max > 1])}")"}
